official_definition: When your Yellow Spirit is blocked, you can refresh five of your Yellow "Bannerace" family Spirits. When not blocked, you can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Violent Windstorm] or [Violent Windstorm: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Violent Windstorm]", "give [Violent Windstorm]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
